description: This file defines the LocalVectorStore class implementing a FAISS-based vector storage system, including methods for adding embeddings, searching, saving, loading, and getting statistics.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A FAISS-based local vector store for managing vector embeddings and their metadata, supporting add, search, save, load, and statistical operations.

methods.name: __init__(self, dimension: int = 3072)
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with a specified dimension and creates a FAISS index.

methods.name: None add_embeddings( self, embeddings: List[List[float]], metadata_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Adds a list of embeddings and their metadata to the index while verifying dimensions and logging the operation.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] search( self, query_embedding: List[float], k: int = 5, filter_chapter: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Performs a similarity search for the provided query vector, optionally filtering by chapter, and returns the top-k results.

methods.name: None save(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Serializes and saves the FAISS index and metadata to disk at the specified path.

methods.name: bool load(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Loads the FAISS index and metadata from disk, returning success status and handling errors.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_stats(self)
methods.description: Returns statistics about the current vector store, including total vectors, dimension, and metadata count.

ctags.name: add_embeddings
ctags.signature: ( self, embeddings: List[List[float]], metadata_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] )

ctags.name: search
ctags.signature: ( self, query_embedding: List[float], k: int = 5, filter_chapter: Optional[int] = None )
